1.0.0.body:
## Changes

- Initial ComfyUI scene detection node using PySceneDetect and VideoHelperSuite video input.
- Support content, adaptive, and threshold detection with configurable minimum scene length.
- Return one representative image per scene, scene metadata as JSON, and the scene count.
- Support representative-frame selection, resizing, and optional JPEG thumbnails.

1.0.1.body:
## Fixes

- Fix threshold detection by removing an unsupported luma-only argument.
- Release video resources when scene detection completes or raises an error.
- Correct the documented image tensor layout and clarify which detectors support luma-only detection.

1.1.0.body:
## Changes

- Upgrade to PySceneDetect 0.7 and headless OpenCV dependencies.
- Use the official scenedetect-headless distribution to avoid a dependency on this node's own Registry package name.

## Fixes

- Improve compatibility with PySceneDetect 0.7 detector interfaces.

1.2.0.body:
## Changes

- Add the recommended Video → Scenes node with ComfyUI's built-in VIDEO input.
- Stream source video without allocating a full IMAGE batch, reducing memory use for long and high-resolution videos.
- Keep the existing VHS node available as Legacy VHS so older workflows continue to load.
- Add workflow examples for built-in VIDEO and Legacy VHS inputs.

## Fixes

- Process legacy image batches one frame at a time to reduce temporary memory allocations.

1.2.2.body:
## Changes

- Add hash and histogram scene detection methods with independent thresholds.
- Add detection downscaling while keeping representative images at the requested output resolution.
- Add default/custom detector settings for adaptive detection, content weights, and fade handling.
- Show only settings relevant to the selected detector method.
- Preserve Legacy VHS widget positions so existing workflows continue to load.
- Automate Registry patch-version preparation and publishing.

## Fixes

- Return one scene and a representative image when no cuts are detected, including trimmed VIDEO inputs.

This release includes the changes previously prepared as 1.2.1. The removed 1.2.1 version is consolidated into 1.2.2.
